notes.subject: putim pes bilong mi long man
notes.rationale: ונתתי פני באיש — 'putim pes long man' i min ol i lukim pes bilong Yahwe i kamapen long en olsem birua

notes.subject: brukim em olgeta
notes.rationale: והשמתיהו — KJV i tanim 'stun/astonish' (ASV 'astonishment'), JPS i no putim; root שמם i min 'mekim i stap nating'

notes.subject: yupela
notes.rationale: 'Na yupela bai save long mi' — tok i go long ol manmeri bilong Yahwe, recognition-formula bilong profet Ezekiel

translation: Na bai mi putim pes bilong mi long dispela man, na bai mi brukim em olgeta, long mak na long stori bilong olgeta man, na bai mi katim em i go ausait long namel bilong ol manmeri bilong mi; na yupela bai save long mi — mi Yahwe.

tokens.gloss: na bai mi brukim em olgeta
na long stori bilong olgeta man
na bai mi katim em i go ausait
